item.title: Afternoon rain fails to deter voters at Pattaya polling stations
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – Afternoon rain did little to discourage voters from turning out to cast their ballots and take part in the national referendum at Ban Thang Rotfai School in Pattaya, Feb 8.
